name: Zul'Farrak: Sergeant Bly and Weegli Blastfuse scale with the rest of the crew (COA-6155)
contract: Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1 and DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1 with the default DestinyWeaver.Scaling.DungeonIds.
Sergeant Bly (7604) and Weegli Blastfuse (7607) carry UNIT_NPC_FLAG_GOSSIP to start the pyramid event, and
ViewableCreature kept the authored level for any creature with an npcflag, so a level-39 character saw the rest of
the crew at 39 and Bly at 45. Gossip alone is not a service: a gossip creature that is hostile or neutral now scales
like its crew (Raven 7605 has no npcflag and is the control). Friendly gossip creatures keep their level through

steps.label: SETUP: Raven, without an npcflag, is seen at the character's level
DISCRIMINATING: hostile Sergeant Bly is seen at the character's level
Hostile Weegli Blastfuse is seen at the character's level
The client is sent Bly's scaled level
